headline: Iran: New Explosions on Kharg Island – Tehran Threatens to Strike American Bases
summary: New explosions were reported on Kharg Island as tensions in the Strait of Hormuz escalate. Both sides are exchanging threats and strikes.
why: Kharg Island is Iran's main crude oil export terminal, so attacks there directly affect global oil supply.
why_moved: Explosions on Kharg Island and exchanged threats in the Strait of Hormuz raise concern about disruption to Gulf oil exports.
